criteria.requirement: A genuine 3D solar system visibly includes the Sun and recognizable planets.
criteria.action: Inspect the Sun and planets from offered views.
criteria.expected: The scene contains a recognizable real-time 3D Sun and planets.

criteria.requirement: Planets visibly orbit the Sun over time rather than only changing textual labels.
criteria.action: Observe the scene at multiple time points.
criteria.expected: Planets visibly orbit the Sun rather than only changing labels.

criteria.requirement: The user can travel or drift among planets and inspect them with usable browser controls.
criteria.action: Use the offered controls to travel between planets.
criteria.expected: The user can drift or navigate among planets and inspect them.

criteria.requirement: The visual presentation communicates scale and wonder without obscuring navigation; allow artistic scaling because literal physical scale was not required.
criteria.action: Inspect the system at near and wide views.
criteria.expected: Presentation conveys scale and wonder while preserving navigation; literal physical scaling is not required.

scenarios.instruction: Inspect the initial solar system and identify the Sun and multiple planets.
Observe orbital motion over time and travel between at least two planets.
Return to the wider system using offered navigation and inspect mobile reachability.

Inspect a 390px-wide viewport, including lower controls and focus navigation. Perform the task through the primary UI without relying on precise 3D camera manipulation. Record any clipped, obstructed or unreachable content.
